api.initialize(profile_path, run_dir, task_s: Returns complete run dict; refuses existing run. Absolute profile path; task_specs list.
api.load_run(run_dir): Returns integrity-checked run dict without mutation.
api.execute(run_dir, action, payload=null, e: Returns action data including revision. Mutations require expected_revision, lock and atomic CAS; preflight/next/verify are read-only. Errors raise EngineError (ValueError subclass).

profile_paths.source_roots: array of absolute existing original directories
profile_paths.publication_root: absolute directory within project_root; outside original roots

source_manifest.path: absolute JSON file; source_manifest may initially be null or omitted

sources.path: absolute original path within source_roots, or omit path/hash and provide exact url for URL-only project review

budget_note: community is a subset of supplementary. Counts are global unique source IDs/hash; reservations checked before claim. profile may lower but not raise 3/20/3 caps.

revise-source-notes.reviewer: Coordinator reviewer; old and new limitations retained in dated source.note_history; only limitations and note_history may change; draft review is invalidated

source_note: date may be null only with nonempty date_note; kind any descriptive string; budget_class annual_report|supplementary|community; community also consumes supplementary. Binary requires readiness_status=ready and extraction_path plus extraction_sha256. Web capture original HTML and optional separate reading text retained. Candidate with local_path=null requires acquisition_status=candidate and cannot support factual claims until reconciled. Public nonbinary URL-only sources require explicit acquisition_status=url-reviewed, readiness_status=ready, exact reviewed manifest URL and entity IDs, no invented file hash. Project selection grants no wiki semantic-ingest authority; legacy selection label accepted for synthetic fixtures only by convention.
fact_note: classification fact|self-description|calculation|hypothesis. Hypothesis can have null source only when uncertainty nonempty; normal facts require reconciled approved original. Quantities add value/unit/metric/definition; calculations add input_fact_ids with matching unit,definition,entity_id,region; incomparable inputs rejected.
gap_note: decision follow-up|unresolved|out-of-scope|resolved; follow-up at most once and only before two distinct unsuccessful search routes. unresolved records honest uncertainty. A later result may update same gap ID with unchanged field and all prior routes retained; history is persisted. resolved needs resolved_by accepted fact ID.
state_notes: run.json sole state of record; checksum detects accidental corruption
run.json.lock fails closed; stale lock removal is manual after verifying no live writer
formal verify reports structural evidence only, never truth
core/profile/strategy hashes pin run; version drift rejects mutation/resume
read-only source manifest is loaded only on init or explicit select-sources; use a new immutable manifest for additional selections
publication copies exact reviewed Markdown bytes locally with durable handoff journal and previous-byte rollback; project README/index integration belongs to coordinator
draft gate requires project ID, exact purpose, status and every source/fact/gap ID; final requires verified non-hypothesis fact per core field and no unresolved critical gap
claim returns task with input_revision and attempt_id; reuse those exact values in result
resume accepts saved current-attempt result even after lease expiry into submitted for mandatory review; older attempts remain reported for explicit review
rework replaces the task's whole active fact set and preserves previous facts in fact_history; external calculations referencing replaced facts fail closed
reconcile preserves blocked readiness as a source state; blocked sources cannot support facts
binary sidecar frontmatter must identify current source_sha256
